provider: Tripo Studio (logged-in browser), DCC Bridge -> Tripo3DUEBridge

balanceLog.when: drowned rigs (8x20) + blightwood 8 generations + maw text-to-motion

pipelineNotes: Studio: text-to-3D HD Model H3.1 Best Quality (55), Ultra Mesh Quality on, T-Pose on, 60k triangles, 4K PBR, remove lighting; Humanoid auto-rig with the UE5 Mannequin skeleton preset (20); preset animations are free; text-to-motion 20 per clip; clips already in the account's AI Animation library (batch-03 war cry, ground slam, bow, crossbow and every new text-to-motion) retarget onto new rigs for free.
Free Retry (x3) regenerates a model under the same task id at no cost (used for withered_matron before re-prompting).

DCC Bridge: open the 'DCC Bridge' popover in the Studio header and switch Unreal on (it must say Connected; the switch resets on every page load). Send To Unreal then streams the FBX in 5 MB chunks to the plugin on 127.0.0.1:60620.

The streaming page must stay in the foreground until the editor logs 'All N chunks received'. Navigating away, a background tab (Chrome timer throttling) or the Studio switching the page to a newly finished generation kills the transfer.

Bridge imports land in /Game/TripoModels/CTS_Race_<Unit>; Tools/RunTripoRacesIntegration.py (skeleton core-redirect workaround + Tools/IntegrateTripoRaces.py) moves them to /Game/Tripo/Races/<race>/<Unit>/, rebuilds the PBR instance on M_Tripo_PBR_Master (BaseColor restored), renames text-to-motion clips and writes Saved/TripoRacesIntegration.json; Tools/WriteRaceMeshes.py then writes Content/Data/RaceMeshes.tripo.json.
Skeletal bodies stay non-Nanite and unscaled (meshScale in data), like batch 03, so M_CireMonsterSkin's rank/race tint (a MID copying the four PBR textures) applies unchanged.
